fact: ACTPOL says Decree No. 816 of 2025 was dated 1 November 2025 but released publicly on 25 December 2025, and that the Alexandria Economic Court ordered EGP 10 million in compensation over a compromise of customer data in September 2025; as of 25 September 2026 the Centre had published no decisions.
title: Egypt's data protection deadline: a regulator inside the executive and a triple lock on data transfers
